name: Linghangzhe No. 2
summary:
Linghangzhe No. 2 (领航者2号) is the Zhejiang Humanoid Robot Innovation Center's full-size humanoid identified as its first product generation in August 2024. The center lists 41 degrees of freedom and describes the platform as extending from walking toward general embodied-intelligence operations.

It follows the earlier Linghangzhe No. 1 prototype, with a distinct joint configuration and a stated focus on precise physical tasks. Specific manipulation capabilities depend on the robot's control software, end effectors and task setup; the center's current NAVIAI models should be assessed separately
